Backpressure / load shedding middleware. Returns 503 when the server is under pressure based on configurable thresholds.Sensible production defaults for backpressure thresholds.Create an empty backpressure state with all counters zero.Current number of in-flight connections tracked by the state.Current number of responses pending completion in the state.Total number of requests shed since the state was created.Reset all backpressure counters back to zero.Backpressure middleware that sheds requests with 503 under pressure.Backpressure middleware with a freshly created state.Backpressure middleware from plain threshold values.
